surfacePrompt: Produce ONE precise material swatch atlas for two top-down orthogonal RPG interiors from original The Elder Scrolls Arena, using the supplied original contact sheet as factual material palette. Digital hand-painted dark fantasy high definition, legible values, not pixel art, not isometric. EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows of square swatches, equal size, no gutters, no text, no borders around the atlas. Each swatch fills its square with continuous seamless material. Row1 col1 red-brown baked rectangular paving tile (IFLOOR6); col2 mottled grey-brown small aggregate floor IFLOOR5; col3 dark grey-blue polished veined marble slab floor FLCASC; col4 black-brown warm veined marble FLCASD. Row2 col1 pale ashlar floor grid FLCAS_E1; col2 flat ochre wooden vertical wainscot panel over a low grey stone plinth, NOBB, orthographic front elevation for wall face; col3 irregular pale grey rounded stone masonry CASC frontal face; col4 rectangular pale grey masonry CASD frontal face. Row3 col1 worn rich dark red woven carpet field; col2 muted turquoise-blue woven carpet field; col3 dark oak grain trim; col4 warm grey squared stone roof/cap surface viewed straight down. Original material colors and distinctions are important, keep rooms luminous enough for characters. No embedded furniture, no doors, no perspective depth, no actors, no ornaments or generated lettering. New materials must be modular and repeatable.
propsPrompt: ONE sheet of eight isolated modular props for a top-down orthogonal RPG town interior, hand-painted dark fantasy matching The Elder Scrolls Arena. Use the original reference for wood/stone/red-and-teal colors. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows of equal square cells on a real transparent background, generous transparent margin inside every cell, no object overlaps a cell. No text or labels. Row1: (1) closed upright red-brown wooden door with subtle iron bands and stable grey stone jambs, flat frontal orthographic wall elevation no floor, tall rectangle 1:2; (2) matching open empty stone door frame, fully transparent opening, same external dimensions; (3) round dark wooden tavern table viewed directly from above with a tiny empty ceramic mug, top surface only and no floor; (4) long rectangular tavern counter viewed directly from above, dark wood, a small teal glass bottle on one end, no bar room or people. Row2: (1) royal wooden throne viewed from elevated orthogonal top-down matching RPG map, seat oriented down/south, restrained faded red cushion and modest geometric brass trim, no person, no faction symbols; (2) small iron brazier viewed from directly above, amber embers with small static flame, no floor shadow; (3) simple tall hanging dark teal cloth panel with ochre-gold edging and a small generic geometric lozenge, flat frontal orthographic display, no writing or invented heraldic creature; (4) squat round carved grey stone pedestal with a small simple bowl fountain viewed top down, no surrounding floor, modest details. All props physically credible medieval construction, stable left/right symmetry on doors, consistent restrained lighting. Do not incorporate any ground tile, floor, wall chunks, rooms, people, weapons or panoramas. Transparent alpha around every object; props kept separate for engine placement.

interpretations: Texturas e objetos em vista superior são adaptações dos materiais e objetos originais, sem copiar a perspectiva em primeira pessoa.
Molduras representam os vãos já abertos. Não há nova mecânica de portas nestes interiores.
Pano verde-azulado com losango e acabamento do trono são interpretação, sem heráldica canônica atribuída.
Ornamentos são camada visual separada e preservam as colisões existentes; os volumes sólidos continuam definidos pela geometria.
status: avaliação visual do responsável pendente nos interiores integrados
